name: Fragment List-Based Rendering Pipeline
definition: A rendering pipeline that processes smoke volumes through four distinct stages (Clear, Construction, Insertion, Evaluation) using fragment lists to store and evaluate per-pixel data, chosen to maintain accuracy and avoid raytracing/self-intersection problems.
summary: The Fragment List-Based Rendering Pipeline is a four-stage method for real-time smoke visualization that separates fragment storage from image synthesis to avoid raytracing artifacts.
